purpose: Preliminary per-image-row pixel-height scale lookup for a fixed warehouse camera. It is based on a quadratic fit to person bounding boxes and an assumed 176 cm reference-person height.
important_limitations: This is a reference-relative estimate, not a camera-calibrated absolute human-height measurement.
The 176 cm reference is an assumption. Replace it with the measured height of the calibration walker for a more meaningful result.
Use only for upright, full-body, non-occluded detections within the observed calibration y-range.
Do not extrapolate to y-coordinates outside the saved lookup range.
Bounding-box variation from posture, gait, clothing, lens distortion, detection quality, and foot/head occlusion produces uncertainty.

reference_person.assumption_description: Provisional UK average adult male-height reference. This should be replaced with the actual measured calibration walker's height if available.
